title: Multiplicativity of Tautological Chow Projections
exact_target: For every g >= 1 and all rational Chow classes a,b on the complex moduli stack A_g of principally polarized abelian varieties, determine whether its canonical lambda_g-pairing projection P to the tautological ring satisfies P(ab)=P(a)P(b).
proved_partial_results: Exact kernel-product, square, and weighted-pairing radical equivalences
Explicit fixed-abelian-surface counterexample to a formal automatic-multiplicativity shortcut, outside the target space
Precise scope and algebraic mechanism of the prior nonsimple-support theorem
All-genus Torelli/product partition cutoff and self-product restriction to possible genera 5, 6, 7
Three exact projected Torelli-square polynomials and five necessary-and-sufficient scalar tests within that family
Sufficient compact-restriction criterion with an explicit unproved geometric hypothesis
remaining_gaps: No vanishing theorem for all weighted products of two elements of ker(P)
No counterexample involving classes on A_g
The five actual Torelli self-intersection integrals were not evaluated
The characteristic-p restriction-image hypothesis and universal multiplicativity remain unproved
source_location: Question 1, printed page 1492, contribution Counting maps to an elliptic curve in several ways
later_related_source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16737v1, 17 August 2026, scoped Gromov-Witten projection results
